sourceText:
Hutspot
By: Anonymous
Published: Tuesday, December 8, 2009 - 11:05pm

Ingredients




2 pounds Beef brisket
1/2 cup Water
1 teaspoon Salt
4 mediums Potatoes, pared and cut into fourths
4 mediums Carrots, sliced
3 mediums Onions, chopped
1/2 teaspoon Salt
1/4 teaspoon Pepper
Snipped parsley
Prepared mustard or horseradish

Preparation

1 Heat beef , water and 1 teaspoon salt to boiling in Dutch oven. reduce heat. Cover and simmer for 1,5 hours. Add potatoes, carrots and onions, sprinkle with salt and pepper. Cover and simmer until beef and vegetables are tender, about 45 minutes. 2 Drain meat and vegetables, reserving broth. Mash vegetables or puree in food mill, mound on heated platter. Cut beef across grain into thin slices, arange around vegetables. Garnish with parsley, serve with reserved broth and the mustard.
